title: Page 5
lines: 「好，你路上小心。」苏坤源此刻心思全放在上官悦身上，叮咛了句，便自行上了马车。
待马车离开后，秋月纳闷地问着身旁的二小姐：「二小姐，你有缺什么东西要买吗？」
「不，我是要去一趟灵凤轩。」话音刚落，纤细身形即往马车相反方向而去。
不会吧？！秋月一愣，随即赶紧跟上。「二小姐等等我啊！」
唉！这事二小姐会不会介入太深了啊！她真怕到时候二小姐会抽不了身。
「少主，已在偏厅准备好茶点，就不知是哪位贵客要来？」
韦翰好奇地问着坐在书案后翻阅书卷的主子。能让少主如此用心命他去天祥楼带回糕点，只怕这位贵客在少主心中不同于一般。
要知道天祥楼的糕点在玄武城可是享有盛名的，作工精致、入口即化，非一般糕点可比。
「若我估计得没错，该是快到了才对。」慕容彻清俊脸上的笑容莫测，目光不离手中书卷。
此时，书房门外响起叩门声，打断正欲再开口询问的韦翰。
「进来。」慕容彻放下手中书卷，看来他等的人来了。
小厮低头走了进来，一抬头，在瞧见少主的笑脸后，心下一凛，忙不迭地开口：
「少主，已照您的吩咐，裴姑娘一来就带她到偏厅等候了。」
「好，下去吧。」慕容彻笑道，看来心情不错。
站在一旁的韦翰一脸讶异，这时才明白原来少主等的人竟是裴二小姐。
「走吧！」慕容彻笑着起身，那笑容里多了抹真心的期待，大步走出书房。
当慕容彻踏进偏厅，黑眸立即锁住坐着等候的裴璎珞身上，眸底隐含狩猎的光芒，清俊脸上的笑容更深了。
「璎珞拜见慕容公子。」裴璎珞起身朝他弯身一福。
「坐吧！尝尝桌上的糕点，这可是天祥楼的糕点，一点也不输给青龙城的春满楼。」
慕容彻笑望着她，替她倒了杯香茗，随着茶香飘散在空气中，裴璎珞柔美的脸上有抹沉田心。
「慕容公子早知我一定会来找你吗？」
杏眸直视他含笑的黑眸。否则又如何解释她一到灵凤轩，常青即命人带她来到这城南大宅，还有桌上这些早已准备好的糕点。
「知道。」慕容彻也无意隐瞒，端起茶杯轻啜了口。
莫非他这是请君入瓮？裴璎珞心底逐渐浮起一股莫名的不安来，表面上却仍强自镇定。
「那慕容公子就该知道璎珞所为何来了？」
「你对苏坤源是抱持着何种情感？」慕容彻不答反问，把玩着手中的茶杯，黑眸精锐地注视着她柔美的小脸，不放过她脸上任何的细微神情。
「我只当他是大哥，并无男女之情。」裴璎珞坦言，并未装成不懂他话中之意。
「很好。」慕容彻对她的回答十分满意，她脸上的神情不像是在说假。
「还望慕容公子成全苏大哥和悦儿两人。」裴璎珞直接挑明来意。
「你与上官悦又是何种关系？」
「悦儿是我的好姐妹，我此番前来玄武城，就是要促成她和苏大哥之间的婚事，还望慕容公子成全这对有情人。」裴璎珞索性如实说了。
「据我所知，苏老爷和夫人对你十分满意，只怕这事不会这么容易吧。」
「这事我自会和两位长辈解释清楚的。」他分明是将一切都调查好了，这人到底意欲为何？
「吃糕点吧。尝尝这块枣泥酥，甜而不腻，入口即化。」夹了块枣泥酥放进她碗里，示意她快吃。
裴璎珞一点胃口也没有，只想尽快将事情谈妥离开；可瞧他的模样，摆明没那么容易放人。只好举箸夹起枣泥酥咬了口，果然如他所言，天群楼的糕点一点也不输给春满楼。
慕容彻看着她细嚼慢咽地吃完枣泥酥后，再用丝绢拭去唇上的饼屑的优雅举止。
「慕容公子的回答呢？」她啜饮了口热茶，等着他的回覆。
慕容彻深深望进她杏眸底，唇角勾笑。「我从未见遇上官姑娘，是上官老爷亟欲攀上慕容家，他心底打的是什么主意，我清楚得很。」
「那……为何慕容公子不干脆拒绝呢？」裴璎珞纳闷地问。
「一开始我的确是清楚地回绝，哪知上官老爷一点也不死心，一再来烦人。我也是直到今日苏兄来找我，才知道他和上官姑娘情投意合的事。」
「既是如此，相信慕容公子必有成人之美才是？」裴璎珞试探地问。
「你错了。我并无成人之美的胸襟，我大可顺了上官老爷之意，将上官姑娘纳为妾室。上官老爷打的如意算盘，我并不打算让他如愿，相反地我要令他赔了夫人又折兵。」慕容彻笑得一脸无害，说出他另外的打算。
「你……」裴璎珞惊愕得杏眸圆睁。这男人怎会这么可恶！他这岂不是明摆着不会善待悦儿？
「要如何慕容公子才肯成全这对有情人呢？」裴璎珞深吸了口气，避免自己情绪过于激动，冷静过后再开口。
「要我放弃上官悦很简单，只要你答应我一件事。」慕容彻黑眸如炬地锁住她。
「什么事？」裴璎珞黛眉微挑。
「拿你自己来换就成了。」慕容彻笑得深沉，说出他的目的。
「慕容公子这话是什么意思？」裴璎珞杏眸大睁，胸口因他的话而急远起伏。
「我说得很明白了，我慕容彻要你裴璎珞。」慕容彻笑脸依旧，黑眸灼热地注视着她，强势霸道的话宛如平地一声雷。
裴璎珞柔美的脸上愀变，杏眸无惧地直视着他，半晌后，娇软的嗓音清晰地响起：
「恕难从命，告辞了！」纤细的娇躯一起，不再多看他一眼，脚步略显仓皇地疾步离开。
尾随在后的秋月则是从刚才就一脸震惊，惊惶地紧跟在二小姐身后离开。
慕容彻注视着她匆忙离去的背影，脸上的笑意久久不散，黑眸底闪耀着势在必得。
翌日一早，苏坤源再去灵凤轩找慕容彻；而一夜辗转反彻无法成眠的裴璎珞则是在房里不安地等候消息。
岂料这一等，直到午后，醉得不省人事的苏坤源被小厮给抬了回来。
苏老爷气得破口大骂。从未见过儿子这副荒唐的模样，而苏夫人则是叹气连连，两人皆不知发生了何事。
见状，裴璎珞心情沉重地返回房里，不难猜测慕容彻会对苏大哥说了些什么。
「二小姐，这下子可怎么办才好？」
秋月担忧地望着主子，二小姐为人作嫁到最后竟连自己也抽不了身。想到昨日慕容彻的话，二小姐可千万别犯糊涂啊！
裴璎珞沉吟不语，走到窗下，望着窗外的朗朗晴空，对映她此刻阴霾的心情。
她这趟来玄武城是否来错了？
叩叩。一道轻叩声响起，吸引了主仆二人的注意，敞开的房门外，站着一名丫鬟。
「裴姑娘，又有你的信了。」
裴璎珞心下泛起一股不安，疾步上前接过信，道了声谢，将房门关上，碎步来到窗下，拆开信来一看，俏脸倏地刷白。
「二小姐，该不会又是上官姑娘写来的信吧？信中写了什么？你别吓我啊！」秋月被她远变的脸色吓着，担忧地问。
「悦儿信中说慕容彻已同意婚事，却是要纳悦儿为妾，悦儿说自己宁死也不同意。」所以这是一封与她诀别的信。
「糟了！我们快去一趟上官府！」裴璎珞手里拿着信，提起裙摆，脚步匆忙走出房。
「二小姐，你千万别激动，悦儿姑娘一定不会有事的。」
content_en:
"Okay, be careful on the road." Su Kunyuan's mind was entirely focused on Shangguan Yue at the moment. He warned and got into the carriage on his own.
After the carriage left, Qiuyue asked the second lady beside her in confusion: "Second lady, are you short of anything to buy?"
"No, I want to go to Lingfengxuan." As soon as he finished speaking, his slender figure headed in the opposite direction of the carriage.
No way? ! Qiuyue was stunned for a moment, then quickly followed. "Second Miss, wait for me!"
Alas! Could the second lady be too involved in this matter? She was really afraid that the second lady would not be able to pull herself out by then.
"Young Master, we have prepared refreshments in the side hall. I wonder which distinguished guest is coming?"
Wickham curiously asked his master who was sitting behind the desk and flipping through the books. To be able to make the young master order him to go to Tianxiang Tower to bring back cakes with such care, I am afraid that this distinguished guest is different from ordinary people in the young master's heart.
You must know that Tianxianglou's pastries are famous in Xuanwu City. They are exquisite in workmanship and melt in your mouth. They are not comparable to ordinary pastries.
"If my estimate is correct, we should be arriving soon." Murong Che had an unpredictable smile on his handsome face, his eyes never leaving the book in his hand.
At this time, there was a knock on the door of the study, interrupting Wickham who was about to ask again.
"Come in." Murong Che put down the scroll in his hand. It seemed that the person he was waiting for had arrived.
The young man walked in with his head lowered. When he looked up and saw the young master's smiling face, his heart trembled and he hurriedly said:
"Young Master, I have followed your instructions. As soon as Miss Pei arrives, I will take her to the side hall to wait."
"Okay, let's go down." Murong Che smiled and seemed to be in a good mood.
Standing aside, Wickham looked surprised. Only then did he realize that the person the young master was waiting for was actually Miss Pei Er.
"Let's go!" Murong Che stood up with a smile, a hint of sincere expectation in his smile, and strode out of the study.
Chapter 2(2)
When Murong Che stepped into the side hall, his dark eyes immediately locked on Pei Yingluo, who was sitting and waiting. There was a hunting light in his eyes, and the smile on Qingjun's face deepened.
"Yingluo pays homage to Mr. Murong." Pei Yingluo stood up and bent towards him.
"Take a seat! Try the pastries on the table. These are Tianxianglou's pastries, not inferior to Chunmanlou in Qinglong City."
Murong Che looked at her with a smile and poured her a cup of fragrant tea. As the fragrance of tea floated in the air, Pei Yingluo's soft face was covered with Shen Tianxin.
"Did Mr. Murong know that I would definitely come to find you?"
Her almond-shaped eyes looked directly into his smiling black eyes. Otherwise, how could she explain that as soon as she arrived at Lingfengxuan, Chang Qing ordered someone to take her to the mansion in the south of the city, as well as these pastries that had been prepared on the table.
"I know." Murong Che had no intention of hiding it, picked up the teacup and took a sip.
Could it be that he is inviting you into the urn? Pei Yingluo gradually felt an inexplicable uneasiness in her heart, but she remained calm on the surface.
"Then Master Murong should know why Yingluo is here?"
"What kind of emotions do you have towards Su Kunyuan?" Murong Che asked in reply without answering, playing with the teacup in his hand, his dark eyes looking sharply at her soft little face, not letting go of any subtle expression on her face.
"I only regard him as the eldest brother, and there is no relationship between men and women." Pei Yingluo said frankly, not pretending not to understand the meaning of his words.
"Very good." Murong Che was very satisfied with her answer, and the look on her face didn't look like she was lying.
"I also hope that Mr. Murong will help Brother Su and Yue'er." Pei Yingluo directly stated her intention.
"What is your relationship with Shangguan Yue?"
"Yue'er is my good sister. I came to Xuanwu City this time to facilitate the marriage between her and Brother Su. I also hope that Master Murong will make this couple happy." Pei Yingluo simply told the truth.
"As far as I know, Mr. Su and Mrs. Su are very satisfied with you. I'm afraid this matter won't be so easy."
"I will explain this matter clearly to the two elders." He had clearly investigated everything. What was this man's intention?
"Let's eat pastries. Try this piece of jujube paste cake. It's sweet but not greasy and melts in your mouth." He put a piece of jujube paste cake into her bowl and motioned for her to eat it quickly.
Pei Yingluo had no appetite at all and just wanted to settle the matter and leave as soon as possible; but looking at his appearance, it was clear that he would not let him go so easily. He had no choice but to pick up the jujube paste cake with chopsticks and take a bite. Sure enough, as he said, Tianqunlou's pastries are not inferior to Chunmanlou's at all.
Murong Che watched her elegant manner as she chewed the jujube paste cake slowly and then wiped the crumbs from her lips with silk silk.
"Where is Mr. Murong's answer?" She sipped the hot tea and waited for his reply.
Murong Che looked deeply into her almond-shaped eyes and smiled at the corners of his lips. "I have never met a Shangguan girl. It's the Shangguan master who is eager to get into the Murong family. I know very well what he has in mind."
"Then...why didn't Mr. Murong just refuse?" Pei Yingluo asked in confusion.
"I did clearly refuse at the beginning, but I didn't know that Master Shangguan didn't give up at all and kept annoying me. It wasn't until Brother Su came to me today that I found out that he and Miss Shangguan were in love."
"That being the case, do you believe that Mr. Murong must have the beauty of an adult?" Pei Yingluo asked tentatively.
"You are wrong. I don't have the ambition for adult beauty. I could have just complied with Master Shangguan's wishes and made Shangguan's girl my concubine. Master Shangguan had a wishful thinking, and I have no intention of letting him get it. On the contrary, I want him to lose his wife and lose his troops." Murong Che smiled harmlessly and revealed his other plans.
"You..." Pei Yingluo's almond-shaped eyes widened in shock. How could this man be so hateful! Isn't it obvious that he doesn't treat Yue'er well?
"How can Mr. Murong be willing to marry these lovers?" Pei Yingluo took a deep breath to prevent herself from getting too excited, and calmed down before speaking.
"It's easy for me to give up Shangguan Yue, as long as you promise me one thing." Murong Che locked her with his dark eyes.
"What's the matter?" Pei Yingluo raised her eyebrows slightly.
"Just trade yourself." Murong Che smiled deeply and stated his purpose.
"What do you mean, Mr. Murong?" Pei Yingluo's eyes widened, and her chest heaved rapidly at his words.
"I made it very clear, I, Murong Che, want you, Pei Yingluo." Murong Che's smile remained unchanged, his dark eyes stared at her with burning eyes, and his strong and domineering words were like thunder on the ground.
Pei Yingluo's soft face changed, and her almond-shaped eyes looked directly at him fearlessly. After a while, her soft voice sounded clearly:
"I'm sorry, I'll take my leave!" The slender figure didn't look at him again and hurried away with a slight haste.
Qiuyue, who was following behind, had a look of shock from just now, and left closely behind the second lady in panic.
Murong Che stared at her hurriedly leaving figure, the smile on his face lingering for a long time, his dark eyes shining with determination to win.
Early the next morning, Su Kunyuan went to Lingfengxuan to find Murong Che again; while Pei Yingluo, who had been tossing and turning all night and unable to sleep, was restlessly waiting for news in her room.
Unexpectedly, it was not until the afternoon that Su Kunyuan, who was drunk and unconscious, was carried back by the servants.
Mr. Su was so angry that he cursed. She had never seen her son look so ridiculous, and Mrs. Su sighed repeatedly. Neither of them knew what was going on.
Seeing this, Pei Yingluo returned to the room with a heavy heart. It was not difficult to guess what Murong Che would say to Brother Su.
"Second Miss, what should we do now?"
Qiuyue looked at her master worriedly. In the end, the second young lady couldn't even get out of the marriage. Thinking of what Murong Che said yesterday, the second lady must not be confused!
Pei Yingluo was silent and walked to the window, looking at the bright and clear sky outside the window, which reflected her gloomy mood at the moment.
Did she come to Xuanwu City by mistake this time?
Knock knock. A light knock sounded, attracting the attention of the master and the servant. Outside the open door, a maid stood.
"Miss Pei, I have your letter again."
Pei Yingluo felt uneasy in her heart. She quickly stepped forward to take the letter, thanked her, closed the door, and walked to the window. She opened the letter and took a look, her pretty face turned pale.
"Second Miss, could it be another letter from Miss Shangguan? What was written in the letter? Don't scare me!" Qiuyue was frightened by her changed expression and asked worriedly.
"Yue'er's letter said that Murong Che had agreed to the marriage, but wanted to take Yue'er as his concubine. Yue'er said that she would rather die than agree." So this was a farewell letter to her.
"Oops! Let's go to Shangguan Mansion quickly!" Pei Yingluo held the letter in her hand, lifted up her skirt, and hurriedly walked out of the room.
"Second Miss, please don't get excited. Miss Yue'er will be fine."
